objectives: To evaluate the efficacy, failures, and complications of resorbable membranes versus non-resorbable membranes in patients undergoing guided bone regeneration (GBR).
inclusion_criteria: Population: patients undergoing guided bone regeneration (GBR) using membranes. Intervention/comparison: use of resorbable membranes vs non-resorbable membranes in guided bone regeneration procedures, or membranes vs a control group. Outcomes/results: efficacy (new bone formation, graft stability), failures (membrane exposure, graft loss, infections, unwanted bone resorption), and clinical complications (inflammation, undesirable bone resorption, need for reoperation). Study design: randomized controlled trials and comparative clinical studies between membrane or control groups. Language: English or Spanish.
exclusion_criteria: Studies that did not directly compare resorbable and non-resorbable membranes, or membranes with respect to a control group; did not report specific bone regeneration results on efficacy or failures; were animal or in vitro studies; or were descriptive studies, systematic reviews, case series, or studies without a comparative group.
